init_FitsDict: create a FitsDict instance that loads SMPL pose fit dictionaries from checkpoint or static fit files
save_FitsDict: save the FitsDict state to disk as numpy arrays for each dataset in the training set
getitem_FitsDict: retrieve batched SMPL pose and beta parameters from the FitsDict with rotation and flip applied
setitem_FitsDict: update FitsDict entries with new SMPL pose and beta parameters after undoing rotation and flip
flip_pose_FitsDict: flip SMPL pose parameters by permuting joints and negating axis-angle dimensions for flipped images
